name: 0.01 OPERATOR Reference Manual (Player Guide)
description:
# 0.01 OPERATOR Reference Manual (Player Guide)

The **OPERATOR** is the player who commands and embodies a Hero or Persona in the Tangent Science Fantasy Roleplay universe. As an Operator, you navigate perilous star-systems, ancient alien ruins, neon arcologies, and high-stakes metaphysical confrontations.

---

## The Persona Folio: Core Attributes & Derivations

Every character in Tangent is built upon **6 Core Attributes**, each coupled with a specialized **Sub-Attribute**:

| Primary Attribute | Core Application | Sub-Attribute | Saving Throw / Check |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Strength (STR)** | Physical power, carrying capacity, melee force | **Might** | Raw muscular lift, break DC, grapple power |
| **Agility (AGI)** | Dexterity, fine motor control, balance | **Reflex** | Initiative, dodge DC, acrobatics, evasion |
| **Stamina (STA)** | Physical endurance, cardio, cellular resilience | **Fortitude** | Disease, poison, wound stabilization, shock |
| **Intellect (INT)** | Deductive logic, technical aptitude, memory | **Logic** | Hacking, investigation, physics, computation |
| **Wisdom (WIS)** | Intuition, spatial awareness, perception | **Will** | Mental defense, fear resistance, psychic grit |
| **Charisma (CHA)** | Social magnetism, leadership, command presence | **Etiquette** | Diplomacy, deceit, negotiation, morale |

---

## The Operator's Three 20-Point Skill Allotments

During character creation, an Operator receives three distinct, dedicated pools of **20 Skill Points (SP)**:

1. **Faction Skill Pool (20 SP):** Allocated among skills taught by your chosen faction or galactic polity.
2. **Origin Skill Pool (20 SP):** Allocated among survival and environmental skills granted by your birthworld or native habitat.
3. **Occupation Skill Pool (20 SP):** Allocated among professional skills defining your training, career, and role.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Skill Rank Caps at Creation:**
> - Recommended starting limit: **Rank 6 (Trained / Professional)**.
> - Maximum hard cap during creation: **Rank 11 (Expert)** (reserved for specialized backstory concepts).
> - Cost: **1 SP = 1 Skill Rank**.

---

## Features, Feats & Perks

- Standard Features cost **3 Build Points (BP)** each.
- **Recommended Features** listed under your Occupation or Faction receive a **1 BP Discount** (costing **2 BP**).
- Ranked Features may be purchased multiple times, stacking bonuses up to your attribute or skill tier limits.

---

## Action Economy in Tactical Combat

Your number of attacks and actions per round is governed directly by your **Combat Skill Rank**:

| Skill Rank | Title / Benchmark | Actions per Round | Focus Strike Bonus |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| **Rank 0** | Untrained | Full Round (1 basic action) | — |
| **Rank 1 – 5** | Novice / Studied | **1st Action** at base score | +2 |
| **Rank 6 – 10** | Trained / Professional | **2nd Action** at base -5 | +3 |
| **Rank 11 – 15** | Expert | **3rd Action** at base -10 | +4 |
| **Rank 16 – 20** | Master | **4th Action** at base -15 | +5 |
| **Rank 21 – 25** | Grand Master | **5th Action** at base -20 | +6 |
| **Rank 26 – 30** | Pinnacle | **6th Action** at base -25 | +7 |

---

## Metaphysics & Reality Manipulation

If your character possesses an **Awakened Discipline**:
- **Attune Check:** Determines the resistance DC of your spell or the evasion DC for targets.
- **Discipline Check:** Determines the intensity, duration, damage, or magnitude of the effect.
- **Essence Pool:** Manage your daily Essence reserves to power Invocations and avoid Strain.
mechanic:
Attack Check = d20 + Combat Skill Rank + Ability Mod + Weapon Modifiers
Active Defense = d20 + Defense Skill + Agility Mod (each successive defense at cumulative -5)
Spell Resistance DC = 10 + Key Ability Mod + Attune Rank + Invocation Level
guide:
1. Check your Persona Folio for current HP, Armor DR, and Essence Pool.
2. On your turn in combat, declare actions up to your Skill Stage limit.
3. Roll d20 + Skill Rank + Attribute Mod vs target DC or Opposed Defense.
note: Operators should balance offensive actions with defensive reserves, as reactive defenses suffer cumulative penalties.

name: 0.02 ARCHITECT Reference Manual (Game Master Guide)
description:
# 0.02 ARCHITECT Reference Manual (Game Master Guide)

The **ARCHITECT** is the Game Master, universe designer, referee, and lead storyteller of the Tangent SFF RPG framework. The Architect sets the parameters of worlds, crafts adversaries and factions, adjudicates rules, and maintains dramatic momentum.

---

## 1. Setting the Stage: World & Civilization Metrics

When establishing star-systems or planetary sectors, assign two fundamental ratings:

### Technology Level (TL 0 to TL 5)
- **TL 0 (Primitive):** Stone, bronze, early combustion, archaic blades.
- **TL 1 (Industrial):** Fossil fuels, early rocketry, ballistic firearms, radio.
- **TL 2 (Atomic / Digital):** Micro-circuitry, fission power, orbital shuttles, lasers.
- **TL 3 (Interstellar / Standard):** Fusion reactors, FTL hyper-lanes, plasma ballistics, cybernetics.
- **TL 4 (Advanced / Cybernetic):** Antimatter power, neural stacks, graviton plating, hard-light.
- **TL 5 (Hyper-Tech / Exotic):** Singularity drives, zero-point energy, reality-warp lattices.

### Metafocus Level (ML 0 to ML 6)
- **ML 0 (Null):** No native meta users or reality warping.
- **ML 1 (Rare):** Negligible population ratio; meta users are feared, revered, or hunted.
- **ML 2 (Selective):** Specialized cults, psionic black-ops, monastery enclaves.
- **ML 3 (Cultured):** Common acceptance; Adepts operate in hospitals, courts, and armies.
- **ML 4 (Standardized):** Integrated into daily life, legal codes, and infrastructure.
- **ML 5 (Advanced):** High-density psionic society; telepathic networks and matter-shaping.
- **ML 6 (Deific):** Transcended civilization (Progenitors / Architects); Non-Player Characters only.

---

## 2. Difficulty Classes (DC) & Adjudication

| Difficulty Level | Target DC | Typical Task Example |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Very Easy / Routine** | **5** | Driving on an open highway, noticing a loud noise |
| **Easy / Standard** | **10** | Picking a simple lock, climbing a ladder in rain |
| **Moderate / Challenging** | **15** | Bypassing an electronic security door, first aid in combat |
| **Hard / Professional** | **20** | Hacking an encrypted corp server, landing in a storm |
| **Very Hard / Master** | **25** | Disarming an active antimatter warhead, tracking in vacuum |
| **Extreme / Heroic** | **30** | Out-piloting a smart missile swarm, subverting an AI core |
| **Near Impossible / Deific**| **35+** | Reshaping tectonic plates with pure metaphysical will |

---

## 3. Adjudicating Opposed vs. Unopposed Rolls

- **Opposed Rolls:** Attacker check vs. Defender check.
  - *Golden Rule:* **DEFENDER WINS ALL TIES**.
- **Unopposed Rolls:** Attacker check vs. Static DC (Base 15 modified for Size, Range, and Movement).

---

## 4. Encounter Balancing & NPC Architecture

Architects can quickly assemble adversary statblocks using the **3-Tier Threat Matrix**:
- **Minions / Grunts:** Fixed 10 HP, No Armor DR, +2 to +4 on attack rolls, 1 action per round.
- **Elites / Enforcers:** 30–50 HP, Armor DR 5–10, +6 to +10 attack roll, 2–3 actions per round.
- **Bosses / Arch-Villains:** 100+ HP, Armor DR 15+, Legendary Reactions, Focus Strike +5, full Metaphysic suites.
mechanic:
Unopposed DC = 15 + Size Modifier + Range Penalty + Movement Modifier
Design DC = (TL * 2) + (ML * 3) + Base Component Difficulty
guide:
1. Establish the planetary TL and ML before designing scenes.
2. Use Base DC 15 for average tasks under pressure; adjust by +/- 5 increments.
3. When resolving opposed checks, award ties to the defending party.
note: Keep the story moving: if a roll fails by 1-2 points, offer a Success at a Cost rather than a hard roadblock.

name: 0.03 BASTION Tactical Assistant & Engine Manual
description:
# 0.03 BASTION Tactical Assistant & Engine Manual

**BASTION** is the integrated Tactical AI Assistant, rules adjudication engine, and combat computation system for the Tangent Science Fantasy Roleplay suite.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Command Syntax

BASTION processes user directives, parses tactical encounters, calculates odds, and resolves dice commands:

### Dice Rolling Engine Syntax
- /roll [count]d[sides]+[mod]
- Examples:
  - /roll d20+6 — Standard attack or skill check.
  - /roll 2d10+4 — Heavy energy blaster damage roll.
  - /roll 3d6+2 — Kinetic slug thrower burst roll.

---

## 2. Core Resolution Formulas

BASTION evaluates mathematical equations across the three modules (**Omnicortex**, **Story Foundry**, and **Persona Folio**):

### Attack & Strike Calculation
\text{Total Strike} = d20 + \text{Skill Rank} + \text{Attribute Mod} + \text{Weapon Mod} + \text{Situational Mod}

### Armor Penetration & Effective Damage
\text{Effective Damage} = \text{Incoming Damage} - \max(0, \text{Armor DR} - \text{Armor Piercing (AP)})

### Metaphysic Potency
\text{Potency Score} = \text{Key Ability} + \text{Discipline Skill Level} + \text{Invocation Level} + 10 \text{ (or } d20 \text{)}

---

## 3. Database Schemas & Relational Integrity

BASTION enforces strict data validation across all DBM collections:
- **Relational Linking:** Items link to prerequisites, species link to inherent traits, and features link to skill requirements.
- **Bi-directional Sync:** Folio character sheets dynamically query Omnicortex DBM entries in real time.
mechanic:
Input: /roll 2d20kh1+5 -> Roll 2d20, Keep Highest 1, Add 5 (Advantage Check)
Damage Soak: EffectiveHP_Loss = max(1, RawDamage - max(0, TargetDR - WeaponAP))
guide:
Type /roll in the BASTION chat bar to execute instant dice operations.
Ask BASTION for rule lookups, NPC generation, and combat odds analysis.
note: BASTION is strictly attuned to the Tangent SFF RPG rulebook and prioritizes mathematical precision.

name: 1.01 Character Creation Pipeline & Derivations
description:
# 1.01 Character Creation Pipeline & Derivations

Creating a character in Tangent Science Fantasy Roleplay is an additive, modular process that blends species biology, cultural upbringing, faction alignment, and professional vocation into a cohesive Persona.

---

## The 8-Step Character Creation Pipeline

1. **Concept & Archetype:** Define your character concept (e.g. Cyber-Samurai, Psionic Diplomat, Void Scout, Alien Scholar).
2. **Species Selection:** Choose a Species. Apply inherent attribute modifiers, bonus skill pools, species traits, and size/movement profiles.
3. **Core Attributes:** Distribute starting Build Points (BP) across the 6 Core Attributes (*STR, AGI, STA, INT, WIS, CHA*).
4. **Faction Selection (20 SP):** Choose a Faction. Allocate the **20 Faction Skill Points** and select 2 Faction Features (with 1 BP discount).
5. **Origin Selection (20 SP):** Choose an Origin environment. Allocate the **20 Origin Skill Points** and choose 2 Origin Traits.
6. **Occupation Selection (20 SP):** Choose an Occupation. Allocate the **20 Professional Skill Points**, choose 2 Occupational Traits, and select Recommended Features.
7. **Hindrances (Up to +15 BP):** Select optional Hindrances to flesh out narrative flaws and earn bonus Build Points.
8. **Gear, Tech & Derived Stats:** Calculate maximum Hit Points, Armor DR, Initiative, Saving Throws, and equip weapons/armor based on Wealth score.

---

## Derived Combat & Survival Statistics

| Statistic | Calculation Formula | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Hit Points (HP)** | $\text{Base (10)} + (\text{Stamina Mod} \times 2) + \text{Rank Multipliers}$ | Total physical trauma capacity |
| **Initiative Check** |  + \text{Reflex Save} + \text{Agility Mod}$ | Reaction speed at start of combat |
| **Might Check** |  + \text{Strength Mod} + \text{Athletics Rank}$ | Physical power, breaking DC, grappling |
| **Fortitude Save** |  + \text{Stamina Mod} + \text{Survival Rank}$ | Resistance to poison, shock, radiation |
| **Reflex Save** |  + \text{Agility Mod} + \text{Acrobatics Rank}$ | Evasion of blast radii and traps |
| **Logic Check** |  + \text{Intellect Mod} + \text{Science/Tech Rank}$ | Deductive analysis and computation |
| **Will Save** |  + \text{Wisdom Mod} + \text{Alertness Rank}$ | Mental grit, fear, and psionic defense |
| **Etiquette Check** |  + \text{Charisma Mod} + \text{Culture Rank}$ | Social poise and diplomatic standing |
mechanic:
BaseHP = 10 + (StaminaMod * 2) + (Level * ClassHealthFactor)
Initiative = d20 + AgilityMod + ReflexSaveMod
guide: Follow steps 1 through 8 in order. Record each 20-point pool separately to ensure compliance with creation limits.
note: Architects should verify that starting skills do not exceed Rank 6 without explicit backstory justification.

name: 1.02 Skill Point Economy & Allocation Pools
description:
# 1.02 Skill Point Economy & Allocation Pools

Skills in Tangent represent formal training, reflex conditioning, and practical experience. All skill ranks are purchased with **Skill Points (SP)** or **Build Points (BP)**.

---

## The Three 20-Point Pools

Every starting character receives three separate, non-transferable pools of 20 Skill Points:

| Pool Name | Source | Purpose | Allowable Skills |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Faction Pool** | Faction / Polity | Cultural, political, and doctrinal training | Listed under chosen Faction |
| **Origin Pool** | Birthworld / Habitat | Survival, environmental adaptation, navigation | Listed under chosen Origin |
| **Occupation Pool** | Career / Profession | Technical, combat, and vocational expertise | Listed under chosen Occupation |

---

## Skill Rank Limits & Creation Caps

- **Cost:** **1 SP = 1 Skill Rank** (or 1 BP = 1 Skill Rank if using general Build Points).
- **Recommended Creation Baseline:** No skill should exceed **Rank 6 (Trained / Professional)** at character creation.
- **Maximum Creation Hard Cap:** Under no circumstance may any starting skill exceed **Rank 11 (Expert)** at character creation.
- Ranks 12–30 are unlocked exclusively through in-game gameplay, progression milestones, and experience rewards.
mechanic:
SkillRank_CreationMax = 11
SkillRank_CreationRecommended = 6
TotalStartingSkillPoints = 20(Faction) + 20(Origin) + 20(Occupation) = 60 SP
guide: Spend exactly 20 points within each respective category list. Do not pool points across different categories.
note: Limiting starting ranks to Rank 6 ensures characters have room for meaningful growth across multiple campaign arcs.

name: 1.03 Feature & Feat Acquisition Rules
description:
# 1.03 Feature & Feat Acquisition Rules

Features (also termed Feats or Perks) represent distinct capabilities, combat maneuvers, specialized augmentations, and metaphysical awakenings.

---

## Cost Structure & Discounts

- **Standard Base Cost:** **3 Build Points (BP)** per Feature.
- **Recommended Feature Discount:** If a Feature is listed in your **Occupation** or **Faction** recommended list, its cost is reduced by **1 BP** (Final Cost: **2 BP**).
- **Minimum Cost:** A Feature can never cost less than **1 BP**, regardless of stacking discounts.

---

## Feature Classifications

1. **Ability Features:** Enhance core physical or mental prowess (e.g. *Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Potent Might, Iron Will*).
2. **Combat Features:** Unlock tactical weapon masteries, critical thresholds, and advanced maneuvers (e.g. *Point Blank Mastery, Dual Wielding, Cleave*).
3. **Meta Features:** Awaken metaphysical disciplines or unlock advanced Invocations (e.g. *Awakened Discipline, Meta Resonance, Overchannel*).
4. **General Features:** Broad utility perks covering wealth, connections, cybernetics, and familiars.
5. **Ranked Features:** Features that can be purchased multiple times. Each purchase stacks benefits, capped by the character's linked Attribute or Skill Tier.
mechanic:
Feature_BaseCost = 3 BP
Feature_DiscountedCost = 2 BP (if Recommended)
Feature_MinCost = 1 BP
guide: Check your Occupation and Faction sheets first to identify discounted Recommended Features before spending Build Points.
note: Ranked features should not exceed the character's attribute modifier or skill stage.

name: 1.04 Factions & Galactic Polities Codex
description:
# 1.04 Factions & Galactic Polities Codex

Factions in Tangent represent the interstellar sovereign powers, megacorporate syndicates, monastic orders, and mercenary guilds that vie for control of the galaxy.

---

## Major Canonical Galactic Polities

### 1. The Dracon Dynasty
- **Archetype:** Feudal Space Monarchy / Dragon-Lord Technocracy.
- **Core Philosophy:** *Protection, Patience, and Long-Term Stability.*
- **Society Structure:** High Nobility (Draconic descendants) ruling over Knightly Dragoons and protected Commoners.
- **Key Skills:** Politics, Piloting, Archaic Weapons, History, Etiquette.

### 2. The Arcology Syndicates
- **Archetype:** Hyper-Capitalist Megacorporate Coalition.
- **Core Philosophy:** *Efficiency, Profitability, and Market Dominance.*
- **Society Structure:** Board of Directors, Executive Officers, and Contracted Citizens.
- **Key Skills:** Business, Computers, Technology, Modern Weapons, Deceit.

### 3. The Cyber-Guilds of Technomancers
- **Archetype:** Transhumanist Cyber-Collective.
- **Core Philosophy:** *Transcendence through Synthesis of Flesh and Machine.*
- **Society Structure:** Fabricators, Circuit-Monks, and Neural Enclaves.
- **Key Skills:** Technology, Computers, Science, Cybernetics, Physics.

### 4. The Holy Federation of Light
- **Archetype:** Theocratic Galactic Concordat.
- **Core Philosophy:** *Spiritual Purity, Cosmic Harmony, and Divine Law.*
- **Society Structure:** Patriarchs, Inquisitors, Templars, and Faithful Laymen.
- **Key Skills:** Religion, Metaphysics, Diplomacy, Fortitude, Will.

---

## The 25 Generic Organizational Templates

Architects and Operators can utilize the **25 Generic Faction Templates** (e.g. Free Trader Consortium, Frontier Militia, Smuggler Ring, Research Institute) to rapidly construct custom organizations with ready-to-use 20 SP packages.
mechanic:

Faction_BonusFeatures = 2 (selected at 1 BP discount)
guide: Choose a faction that aligns with your character's cultural worldview, ethical code, and allegiances.
note: Faction standing affects social reaction DCs when dealing with rival or allied organizations.

name: 1.05 Origins & Habitats Codex
description:
# 1.05 Origins & Habitats Codex

A character's Origin defines their birthworld, native planetary biome, or orbital habitat. Origin environments instill instinctive survival mechanisms and physical conditioning.

---

## Canonical Origin Environments

| Origin Name | Environment Profile | Key Society Skills | Example Origin Traits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Agricultural (Agri-World)** | Low development, fertile plains, farm arcologies | Piloting, Alertness, Nature, Survival | *Green Thumb, Animal Husbandry, Farm Mech* |
| **Arcology (Mega-City)** | Dense urban towers, neon corridors, artificial atmosphere | Computers, Stealth, Technology, Streetwise | *Urban Stalker, Grid Runner, Dense Crowd Evasion* |
| **Asteroid Belt (Void Habitat)** | Zero-g mines, pressurized domes, cold vacuum | Piloting, Physics, Technology, Alertness | *Zero-G Acclimation, Vacuum Intuition, Seal Repair* |
| **Death World (Hostile Ecology)** | Extreme predators, toxic flora, volatile tectonic cycles | Survival, Athletics, Alertness, Medicine | *Apex Predator Reflexes, Toxin Tolerance, Iron Gut* |
| **High-Gravity World** | Crushing gravity, dense planetary core | Athletics, Might, Fortitude, Intimidation | *Dense Muscle Mass, Impact Resistance, Heavy Stride* |
| **Low-Gravity / Void Station**| Microgravity, centrifugal rings, orbital platforms | Acrobatics, Piloting, Physics, Computers | *Light-Footed, Kinetic Drift, Micro-Thruster Mastery* |

---

## Origin Allotment Rules

- **Origin Skill Pool:** **20 Skill Points** distributed among the origin's listed skills.
- **Origin Traits:** Choose **Two Traits** from your native origin list at character creation.
- **Secondary Origin:** An Operator may select a secondary origin to broaden trait options without receiving additional points.

name: 1.06 Occupations & Careers Codex
description:
# 1.06 Occupations & Careers Codex

An Occupation represents a character's career, formal trade, and role in society. It supplies professional skills, discounted recommended features, and career traits.

---

## Canonical Career Archetypes

### 1. Adept (Metaphysic Specialist)
- **Role:** Reality manipulation, psionic warfare, spiritual counseling.
- **Professional Skills:** Attune, Known Metafocus Disciplines.
- **Recommended Features:** Awakened Discipline, Meta Focus, Energy Channeling.

### 2. Soldier (Tactical Combatant)
- **Role:** Direct fire, heavy weapon deployment, squad coordination.
- **Professional Skills:** Modern Weapons, Archaic Weapons, Tactics, Athletics, Armor.
- **Recommended Features:** Toughness, Point Blank Mastery, Heavy Armor Training.

### 3. Scout (Recon & Exploration)
- **Role:** Pathfinding, infiltration, sniper overwatch, planetary survey.
- **Professional Skills:** Stealth, Alertness, Navigation, Survival, Piloting.
- **Recommended Features:** Lightning Reflexes, Camouflage Mastery, Eagle Eye.

### 4. Scholar / Scientist (Research & Analysis)
- **Role:** Forensics, astrophysics, xenobiology, historical deciphering.
- **Professional Skills:** Academics, Science, Physics, Computers, Medicine.
- **Recommended Features:** Mastermind, Fast Hacking, Analytical Deduction.

### 5. Scoundrel (Subterfuge & Infiltration)
- **Role:** Security bypassing, street economics, black-market procurement.
- **Professional Skills:** Stealth, Deceit, Streetwise, Lockpicking, Sleight of Hand.
- **Recommended Features:** Slippery, Hidden Pocket, Quick Draw.

---

## Occupational Rules

- **Professional Skill Pool:** **20 Skill Points** allocated to occupational skills.
- **Occupational Traits:** Select **Two Traits** from your career archetype.
- **Cross-Training (Background Trait):** Take the *Background* trait to acquire training from a secondary occupation.

Occupation_SkillPool = 20 SP
Occupation_Traits = 2
RecommendedFeatures_Discount = 1 BP
guide: Distribute your 20 professional SP across career skills to establish your primary in-game competencies.
note: Characters can multiclass or take on new occupations during long campaign downtime periods.

name: 1.07 Master Skills Codex & Benchmarks
description:
# 1.07 Master Skills Codex & Benchmarks

Skills are organized into **5 Major Skill Groups**. Every rank adds a +1 bonus to task resolution checks.

---

## Master Skill Directory

### I. Physical Skills (STR / AGI)
- **Acrobatics (AGI):** Tumbling, balance, aerial maneuvers, fall mitigation.
- **Athletics (STR/STA):** Sprinting, swimming, climbing, heavy lifting, physical endurance.
- **Piloting (AGI/INT):** Starships, ground speeders, mecha, atmospheric craft.
- **Stealth (AGI):** Hiding, silent movement, camouflage, shadow traversal.

### II. Mental Skills (INT / WIS)
- **Alertness (WIS):** Perception, hazard awareness, detecting hidden foes.
- **Academics (INT):** Research, linguistics, humanities, ancient history.
- **Computers (INT):** Cyber warfare, system intrusion, AI interaction, programming.
- **Investigation (INT):** Forensics, crime scene analysis, deductive logic.
- **Medicine (INT):** Combat triage, surgical intervention, pathology, cyber-surgery.
- **Science (INT):** Chemistry, biology, xenology, planetary physics.
- **Technology (INT):** Engineering, field repairs, weapon maintenance, fabrication.

### III. Social Skills (CHA)
- **Culture (CHA):** Etiquette, protocol, xenological customs.
- **Deceit (CHA):** Bluffs, disguises, misdirection, undercover infiltration.
- **Diplomacy (CHA):** Negotiation, treaties, conflict resolution, persuasion.
- **Intimidation (STR/CHA):** Coercion, interrogation, psychological pressure.
- **Streetwise (CHA/WIS):** Black market contacts, criminal underground navigation.

### IV. Combat Skills (AGI / STR)
- **Archaic Weapons (AGI/STR):** Swords, polearms, bows, thrown weapons.
- **Modern Weapons (AGI):** Pistols, rifles, shotguns, submachine guns.
- **Advanced / Heavy Weapons (STR/INT):** Plasma cannons, missile launchers, railguns.
- **Unarmed Combat (STR/AGI):** Martial arts, brawling, grappling, subdual.
- **Defense / Evasion (AGI):** Active dodges, parrying, kinetic deflection.

### V. Metafocus Skills (INT / WIS / CHA)
- **Attune (WIS/INT):** Drawing, channeling, and stabilizing metaphysical energy.
- **Discipline Skills (6 Branches):** Dimension, Energy, Entropy, Illusion, Matter, Mental.

name: 1.09 Hindrances & Karmic Debt Codex
description:
# 1.09 Hindrances & Karmic Debt Codex

Hindrances are character flaws, phobias, debts, and physical disabilities that grant bonus **Build Points (BP)** at character creation.

---
